exposure: Geographical location (rural vs. urban districts in Zimbabwe)
cohort: The study included 10,947 'standard primiparae' (women in their first pregnancy without known complications, with spontaneous onset of labour at term) identified from 45,240 births in Zimbabwe.
finding: The perinatal mortality rate (PNMR) was significantly higher in rural districts (19/1000 total births) compared to urban districts (11/1000 total births, p < 0.001).
